sections.title: Secret the first room
sections.subtitle: Take the split the Bers left for you
lines: As Tank you have the worst clear potential that is not part of the bloodrush.
Secret the first room, then take whatever split the Bers has left for you.
When you finish clearing to a dead-end, secret backwards until you reach a room that is not a dead-end.
Midclear once all puzzles are opened.

sections.title: Agro Maxor
sections.subtitle: Hold right click, run past Maxor to the conveyor
lines: When the boss spawns, swap to your tank loadout and put your halberd of the shredded in your hotbar.
Hold right click as you run at and past Maxor to the conveyor belt in order to agro him.
Use your ultimate ability as Maxor reaches the conveyor belt and hit some lbs.
Then swap to your flaming flay/soul whip and apply lethality until your archer and mage dps Maxor.

sections.title: Pad yellow for Storm
sections.subtitle: Pad yellow 37.1-37.9, step off at 38.00
lines: Leap down to the Bers after Maxor dies and run to the yellow pad.
Set it up so that it is 2 away from the top (halfway down).
Clear the mobs between yellow and purple.
Stand right next to the purple pad with a spirit mask on for lightning (look at Storm).
When the Mage leaps to you, quickly leap to the Healer, then turn right, jump and go up to the yellow pad.
The time for which you pad yellow is 37.1-37.9.
The pad will begin moving at 38.00 (this is when you can step off).
It finishes crushing at 39.00.
The mage will then agro Storm into the pillar at either 40.00 or 41.00; this works for both.

sections.title: S1: Open 2, then 1
sections.subtitle: Spam click 2, then complete 1
lines: Tank's role in terms is: 21 / 1 (3/rl) / 1 bl / 1.
When Storm is over, leap to the healer and setswap to your terms loadout, then move to 2.
Spam click 2 as the section begins to instantly open it and complete the terminal.
Then move to the left and complete 1.
If your archer gets a melody on 4, leap to them and stack 3.
If not, preleap to the Mage for ee2.

sections.title: S2: Flick right, do 1
sections.subtitle: Flick 105 degrees right, hold w, land at 1
lines: Flick around 105 degrees to the right and hold w to walk off hee2 and land at 1.
You can stand in the safe spot at 1 if ss resets or is not fast.
When S2 starts, complete 1 and leap to your bers.
If the bers has a melody on 5, do 3.
If the archer has a melody on 4, do the right lever.
If neither has a melody, either stack 3 with the bers or simply leap to the healer for ee3.

sections.title: S3: Do 1, stack levers
sections.subtitle: Turn around and jump to 1
lines: After leaping to the healer, turn around and jump to get to 1.
After completing 1, leap to the archer and stack the levers.
Leap to the mage for core.

sections.title: S4: Run to 1
sections.subtitle: Run to 1, leap back to mage for recore
lines: Run as quickly as you can to 1.
Then leap back to the mage for recore.
Swap to any unpopped mask to prepare for Goldor.

sections.title: Pop mask on Goldor
sections.subtitle: Mask left: rush out, ice spray Goldor
lines: If you used all your masks in terms, swap a wither cloak into your hotbar.
Do not rush out; just survive inside of core.
If you do have a mask left, rush out and jump at Goldor with an ice spray wand, instantly popping your mask.

sections.title: Last breath Necron
sections.subtitle: Fire after Necron moves left or right
lines: When Necron drops you, leap to the mage or run to the front of the platform with the mage.
Charge your last breath.
Fire after Necron moves laterally (he always moves either left or right at the start) to boost the Archer and Mage's dps as soon as possible.
Once he goes mid, last breath him 5 times.
Repeat this every time he redoes the fire phase and returns to middle.
Leap to the healer once he is dead.

sections.title: Place Green relic
sections.subtitle: Leap to Archer, tap d to place Green
lines: Swap to black cat and a cow hat, and spam click.
Immediately leap to the Archer as soon as possible.
Tap d to place the Green relic.

sections.title: Debuff the dragons
sections.subtitle: Ice spray at jump peak, then lethality
lines: As tank you are purely a debuff class.
Stand middle with your teammates and swap in your last breath, ice spray wand, soul whip or flaming flay, and twilight arrow poison (and flints if your ping is >50).
When you see the title, run to the dragon and begin prefiring your last breath under the statue.
With .15 to spawn, jump and ice spray at the peak of your jump.
Then swap to your soul whip / flaming flay and apply lethality.
Continue this for the final 3 dragons, making sure you have enough twilight for all of them.
